rows.grounds: ablative sense expressing cause or means; derived from pūjana with -tas suffix
intensifying particle modifying the following verb
predicate expressing the goddess's gracious response

items.question: Through what act does the goddess Bhavānī become greatly pleased?
premises: Worship is performed toward the goddess.
The goddess Bhavānī is the recipient of this worship.
The act of worship produces a gracious response in her.
items.inference: Therefore, worship causes the goddess Bhavānī to become greatly pleased.
items.plain_english: Through worship, the goddess Bhavānī becomes very pleased.
